game_moneyline_spread#cfbd_fcs_coverage.description: The data plan assumes CFBD exposes plays, drives, PPA and rating series for FCS teams; CFBD advanced metrics and SP+ are believed to cover FBS only, so ratings for FCS opponents (KXNCAAFCSGAME, FBS-vs-FCS spread tails, and, in game_total, HIGHSCORE) may need an own FCS rating built from scores.
game_moneyline_spread#cfbd_fcs_coverage.what_would_resolve: Query CFBD for FCS game ids and check plays, drives and SP+ availability by season; if absent, define an own score-based FCS rating (Elo-style) and its uncertainty.

game_moneyline_spread#d3_score_source.description: The D3/FCS margin model assumes complete Division III score history from NCAA scoreboards, D3football.com or Massey; completeness of D3 coverage, neutral-site flags and playoff seeds across 2010-2025 has not been checked.
game_moneyline_spread#d3_score_source.what_would_resolve: Scrape two seasons of D3 scores from each source, reconcile game counts against NCAA totals and confirm neutral and playoff flags.

game_moneyline_spread#injury_feed_gap.description: There is no official per-player injury report in most conferences, so cfb.injuries and the snap-weighted loss can only be built from beat reporters and team releases; coverage and timeliness are unknown and vary by program.
game_moneyline_spread#injury_feed_gap.what_would_resolve: Run a season-long timestamped capture pipeline and measure coverage against post-game participation (who actually played) to estimate miss rate by conference.

game_moneyline_spread#ml_ot_tie_unstated.description: KXNCAAFGAME and KXNCAAFSPREAD rules text was read but never states whether overtime points count or how a tie or a suspended game resolves; the CSGAME and D3GAME texts state a 50/50 tie payout, so the FBS series may differ.
game_moneyline_spread#ml_ot_tie_unstated.what_would_resolve: Ask Kalshi or inspect settled KXNCAAFGAME/KXNCAAFSPREAD overtime games to confirm overtime is included in the winner and margin.

game_moneyline_spread#pace_attachment.description: cfb.pace and cfb.drives are now attached to stage s4 and pace_volume coverage, but whether they are primary or secondary for margin variance, and how much they overlap offense_style, is untested.
game_moneyline_spread#pace_attachment.what_would_resolve: Test margin-variance heteroskedasticity against combined forecast possession count on historical games and drop the weaker of pace and offense_style if redundant.

game_moneyline_spread#spread_ot_treatmen.description: The sampled KXNCAAFSPREAD rules do not state whether overtime points count toward the margin; a margin of 1 to 7 after overtime versus a tie after regulation changes rung probabilities near key numbers.
game_moneyline_spread#spread_ot_treatmen.what_would_resolve: Read the full live rules_primary/secondary for several KXNCAAFSPREAD tickers or ask Kalshi support whether overtime counts.

game_stat_props#air_yards_coverage.description: Depth of target, pressure and personnel are not provided by any free source with confirmed coverage across all FBS games; the completion yardage profile may have to rely on yards per completion proxies.
game_stat_props#air_yards_coverage.what_would_resolve: Verify CFBD fields and obtain a PFF or Sports Info Solutions sample for 20 games to measure the proxy error.

game_stat_props#cfbd_receiver_field.description: The data plan assumes CFBD play-by-play carries a usable receiver and yards field for every pass play 2014 onward; team receiving yards may instead need reconstruction from play text, and may not match the official figure used for settlement.
game_stat_props#cfbd_receiver_field.what_would_resolve: Sample CFBD plays across seasons, test receiver-field completeness, and compare reconstructed team receiving yards to official box-score totals for 200 games.

game_stat_props#official_provider.description: The sampled rules say official final result but do not name the statistics provider; CFBD and ESPN box scores can disagree with the official figure by a few yards on lateral or review plays, and a single yard can decide a rung.
game_stat_props#official_provider.what_would_resolve: Identify the Source Agency named in the full rules text and compare 50 past games against CFBD and ESPN totals.

game_stat_props#other_stat_props_rules.description: The touchdown-count series (TEAMTD, TOTALTD, RSHTD, RECTD, DSTTD, FIRSTTDTEAM) now have rules text read here, but KXNCAAFTEAMTD does not say whether the team's defensive and special-teams touchdowns count, and the RSHTD/RECTD samples are truncated after the 2-point sentence, so their remaining clauses are not read.
game_stat_props#other_stat_props_rules.what_would_resolve: Full rules text for KXNCAAFTEAMTD, TEAMRSHTD and TEAMRECTD, or a settled TEAMTD market in a game with a return touchdown.

game_stat_props#receiving_yards_definiti.description: The sampled rule text excludes 2-point conversion yards and counts first and second overtime, but does not define receiving yards itself (negative yards, laterals, trick plays), so the equivalence team receiving yards = yards on completions is domain knowledge not read from the rules.
game_stat_props#receiving_yards_definiti.what_would_resolve: Obtain the full live rules and the official NCAA stat definition, and reconcile the figure for a sample of completed games.

game_stat_props#rush_attempt_rules.description: KXNCAAFTEAMRSHATT (moved here from team_total by the reconciliation) is TITLE_ONLY: no listed market or rules text; whether sacks and kneel-downs count as rushing attempts (NCAA statistics count them) and whether overtime attempts count directly sets the mean of the count.
game_stat_props#rush_attempt_rules.what_would_resolve: A listed TEAMRSHATT market with rules text, or Kalshi confirmation of the statistic definition and provider.

game_stat_props#situational_effect_untes.description: Rest, travel, rivalry and motivation effects on passing volume are not defined as inputs; there is no evidence either way in this archetype that they matter at the 20-30 yard scale of a receiving threshold.
game_stat_props#situational_effect_untes.what_would_resolve: Add rest and rivalry flags to a residual regression of receiving yards on the main drivers and test significance across five seasons.

game_total#crew_assignment_timing.description: Conference practices on announcing officiating crews differ and some are posted only game week; there is no confirmed free feed that gives crew assignment before most markets close.
game_total#crew_assignment_timing.what_would_resolve: Survey each conference's crew-assignment publication timing for one season and record the share of games with a known crew at 24 hours before kickoff.

game_total#explosive_dispersion.description: Right-tail behaviour of totals depends on explosive-play rates and non-offensive touchdowns, but the proper opponent-adjusted definition of explosiveness (IsoPPP versus 20-plus yard rate) is not settled for FBS with its thin connectivity.
game_total#explosive_dispersion.what_would_resolve: Backtest tail calibration of the total distribution using each definition on held-out seasons.

game_total#highscore_universe.description: KXNCAAFHIGHSCORE says 'a Division I game' without defining whether games between a Division I team and a Division II/NAIA opponent count, and the record cannot confirm free coverage of FCS-FCS game scores; both change the number of games in the season maximum.
game_total#highscore_universe.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification of 'Division I game' and a check that NCAA or CFBD lists every FCS-FCS and FCS-non-D-I score for 2005-2025.

game_total#situational_totals_effect.description: There is no input for rest, lookahead, rivalry and conference-title stakes on tempo and scoring; their effect on totals is not established and they may matter in specific games such as rivalry week and the final regular-season weekend.
game_total#situational_totals_effect.what_would_resolve: Regress total residuals on rest, rivalry flag and lookahead across seasons using non-market expected totals.

game_total#total_ot_treatment.description: The sampled KXNCAAFTOTAL rules never say whether overtime points count, although the title says Full Game and sibling series state including or excluding overtime explicitly; the probability of crossing a rung near the median differs by a few points depending on the answer. Resolution triggers an explicit input choice: overtime counted means cfb.ot_model (and the overtime archetype tie curve) is required; regulation-only means it is not.
game_total#total_ot_treatment.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules_primary and rules_secondary of several live KXNCAAFTOTAL tickers and, if still silent, check settlement of a past overtime game.

game_total#wind_proxy_validity.description: cfb.stadium_wind_exposure relies on airport-station observations (NOAA ISD, Meteostat) as a proxy for on-field wind and on a public forecast archive that does not exist; the forecast-vs-observed calibration over 8 seasons therefore cannot be built historically and the station proxy error is itself unmeasured.
game_total#wind_proxy_validity.what_would_resolve: Compare airport-station wind to on-site or nearest-sensor wind at a sample of stadiums, and start forward capture of forecast vintages to calibrate over a season.

overtime#fcs_line_score_source.description: KXNCAAFMOSTOT and the season exposure cover any Division I game including FCS, but the tie curve is fitted on FBS games and no FCS line-score source with overtime periods is confirmed; FCS scoring, kickers and FBS-vs-FCS mismatches may change tie and overtime rates.
overtime#fcs_line_score_source.what_would_resolve: Check whether CFBD, NCAA statistics or sports-reference give FCS period line scores with overtime back to 2005, then fit the FCS curve separately.

overtime#late_decision_causality.description: The decision profile is learned from observed play calls and may confound coach intent with game state and personnel; separating kneel to overtime from running out of time is not straightforward in available play-by-play.
overtime#late_decision_causality.what_would_resolve: Hand-label a sample of 200 late-game states to validate the automated classification against coach statements.

overtime#mostot_scope.description: The sampled KXNCAAFMOSTOT text scopes to the 2026 regular season and sibling HIGHSCORE text excludes championship, bowl and CFP games, so scope is reasonably established; the truncated sample does not say how a game halted by weather during overtime counts.
overtime#mostot_scope.what_would_resolve: Read the full live rules of KXNCAAFMOSTOT, and ask Kalshi support how suspended overtime games are handled.

overtime#ot_history_source.description: The long-overtime history (games with 5+ overtimes since 1996, the overtime format regime by season) is assumed obtainable from CFBD line scores and NCAA records; coverage for FCS and pre-2005 games is not confirmed and the per-period tie rate of 0.25 to 0.35 for the first two overtimes is asserted without a sourced estimate.
overtime#ot_history_source.what_would_resolve: Pull overtime line scores from CFBD and NCAA records for 1996-2025, count games by number of overtimes, and estimate the per-period continuation rate with an interval.

overtime#ot_rule_history.description: The NCAA overtime procedure changed over time (alternating two-point attempts began in the third overtime in the late 2010s and some seasons altered procedures); the exact season boundaries for the regime change are not verified here and affect the historical frequency of long games.
overtime#ot_rule_history.what_would_resolve: Read NCAA football rule-book change history for 1996-2026 and tabulate the first season each OT rule variant applied.

overtime#small_sample_tail.description: Games with six or more overtimes number only a handful in thirty years, so the continuation probability from the third overtime cannot be fit from data and must be derived from the two-point rate model; its validity near p about 0.5 is untested.
overtime#small_sample_tail.what_would_resolve: Compile all FBS/FCS games with 5+ overtimes since 1996, then compare the observed counts with the geometric prediction.

quarter_and_half_sides#period_matchup_ga.description: No existing input captures period-specific matchup structure (scripted openers versus fast starters, halftime adjustment quality, second-half tempo changes); evidence that such effects exist beyond noise is thin in a 12-game sample per team.
quarter_and_half_sides#period_matchup_ga.what_would_resolve: Estimate team-level persistence of period-share residuals across seasons; if the year-to-year correlation is near zero, document the gap as noise.

quarter_and_half_sides#period_tie_payout.description: The complete KXNCAAF1H/1Q-4Q rules text has no tie clause; reading 'wins the period' literally, a tied quarter (roughly 20-30 percent for even teams) resolves both team markets No, but this is inferred, not stated, unlike the explicit Tie strike of KXNCAAF1HWINNER.
quarter_and_half_sides#period_tie_payout.what_would_resolve: Inspect settlement of past KXNCAAF1Q-4Q markets on tied quarters (both No versus refund) or obtain Kalshi's confirmation.

quarter_and_half_totals#btts_rules_missi.description: The both-teams-to-score series (KXNCAAF1QBTTS, 2QBTTS, 3QBTTS), moved here by the reconciliation, have no listed market and no rules text, so whether a safety, a defensive touchdown or a two-point return counts as the team scoring in the quarter cannot be stated.
quarter_and_half_totals#btts_rules_missi.what_would_resolve: A listed BTTS market with rules text or a Kalshi statement of what counts as scoring in a quarter.

quarter_and_half_totals#drive_clock_vint.description: Period line scores and drive start/end clock are assumed available from CFBD games and drives endpoints for 2014 onward, but clock fields at drive boundaries are inconsistent in public play data, especially for the last drive of each half, and the end-of-period truncation fraction (0.1 to 0.3) depends on them.
quarter_and_half_totals#drive_clock_vint.what_would_resolve: Audit CFBD drive clock fields against official play-by-play for a sample of games per season and measure missing or inconsistent last-drive clocks by half.

quarter_and_half_totals#garbage_threshol.description: The garbage-time thresholds by quarter (for example Q3 margin above 27, Q4 above 21) are assumed from published practice and not verified here; the proper definition could differ for FCS or for rule-regime changes.
quarter_and_half_totals#garbage_threshol.what_would_resolve: Verify thresholds from the published SP+ methodology and test sensitivity by changing them by plus or minus 7 points.

quarter_and_half_totals#opponent_matchup.description: No definition exists for a period-specific matchup effect between an offence and a defence; season-level adjusted efficiencies may suffice but period variation in defensive scheme (nickel vs base) is not captured in available data.
quarter_and_half_totals#opponent_matchup.what_would_resolve: Test whether adding period-specific opponent-adjusted efficiency improves out-of-sample period-total log loss.

quarter_and_half_totals#quarter_total_no.description: Whether quarter-specific structural effects (scripted openers, two-minute drills, halftime adjustment) are large enough to beat a simple share-of-game-total model is unknown; with 5-6 drives per quarter much of the variation may be irreducible noise.
quarter_and_half_totals#quarter_total_no.what_would_resolve: Out-of-sample comparison on 5 seasons of quarter totals of the share model against a model with period-specific features, scored by log loss at the .5 rungs.

quarter_and_half_totals#team_total_perio.description: The KXNCAAF1HTEAMTOTAL primary text sets first-half scope ('scores over 6.5 points in the 1st half'), so only suspension handling is unstated; no sampled series covers team totals for quarters or second halves.
quarter_and_half_totals#team_total_perio.what_would_resolve: Read the full live KXNCAAF1HTEAMTOTAL rules for a suspension clause and list any team-total series for other periods.

season_futures#bowl_eligibility_rule.description: cfb.bowl_selection_state flags eligibility at six raw wins; the NCAA rule that only one win over an FCS opponent counts, the 5-7 APR fallback order and 2026 waivers are not verified here and change which bubble teams are eligible for KXNCAAFBOWLGAME.
season_futures#bowl_eligibility_rule.what_would_resolve: The 2026 NCAA postseason bowl-eligibility bylaw text and the APR fallback list procedure.

season_futures#cfbd_rankings_source.description: The plan treats the CFBD rankings endpoint (CFP committee history 2014 onward), the ESPN Strength of Record scrape and the CFBD returning-production endpoints as available; none was checked, only portal coverage was flagged.
season_futures#cfbd_rankings_source.what_would_resolve: Query each endpoint or page for several seasons and record coverage, field names and whether weekly vintages are preserved.

season_futures#coach_effect_gap.description: No input separates coach effect from team ratings for futures; coach exits, contract status and offensive/defensive coordinator turnover matter for multi-year contracts but their size relative to roster talent is unknown. The ledger already carries a coach-out hazard archetype whose features bear directly on KXNCAAFTFUT; they are not yet attached here.
season_futures#coach_effect_gap.what_would_resolve: Import cfb.coach_exit_hazard_features and cfb.coach_buyout_exposure from the unreg:coaching_and_governance_events record as the coach-change inputs for multi-year contracts such as KXNCAAFTFUT, then measure coach effect on rating residuals.

season_futures#committee_model_duplicati.description: The CFP committee resume model (cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model) is re-derived here and as cfb.cfp_ranking_resume_features in the polls archetype, a duplication risk: a change to one would not propagate to the other.
season_futures#committee_model_duplicati.what_would_resolve: Choose one canonical committee-behaviour input in the catalog and alias the other.

season_futures#conf_count_dependence_fit.description: The conference-level shock tau_c in cfb.conf_schedule_win_dependence is an unfitted 1.5-point placeholder; the variance of the count of 10-win teams, and so the N+ rungs of SECWINS/BIGTENWINS/BIG12WINS/ACCWINS, is sensitive to it.
season_futures#conf_count_dependence_fit.what_would_resolve: Fit tau_c on 2014-2025 non-conference results and back-test the simulated count distribution against realized 10-win counts by conference.

season_futures#fcs_ivy_mechanism.description: KXNCAAFFCS, KXNCAAFCS and KXNCAAFD3 have rules text (win the FCS or Division III national championship), but cfb.lower_division_title_model is only a sketch with no validated FCS or D3 rating, and the Ivy series (TITLE_ONLY) may pay shared titles.
season_futures#fcs_ivy_mechanism.what_would_resolve: Validate a score-based FCS/D3 rating against past playoff outcomes and read the KXNCAAFIVY rules once listed.

season_futures#nil_resource_data.description: Revenue-sharing and NIL budgets, a major driver of program strength since 2021, are not published systematically, so the trajectory index cannot include them; proxies (collective reporting, rankings) have unknown reliability.
season_futures#nil_resource_data.what_would_resolve: Obtain a paid dataset (On3 NIL valuations are estimates, SOURCE_UNVERIFIED) or approximate by athletic department revenue from public filings and test explanatory power.

season_futures#playoff_format_2026.description: The CFP format for the 2026-27 season (number of teams, automatic bids, seeding rule) and the status of the 24-team expansion decision are not verified here, and the format regime changes berth probabilities materially.
season_futures#playoff_format_2026.what_would_resolve: Read the CFP management committee announcements for 2026-27 and tabulate format by season since 2024.

season_futures#seeding_rule_2026.description: SEED and TOPSEED settle on the committee's seed assignment, but the sampled text does not say which seeding rule applies (top seeds reserved for conference champions or straight seeding by ranking), nor what happens if the format changes before selection.
season_futures#seeding_rule_2026.what_would_resolve: Read the 2026-27 CFP selection protocol and seeding rule and record it in cfb.playoff_format with its effective date.

season_futures#tfut_horizon_model.description: KXNCAAFTFUT spans several seasons after Issuance under an uncertain CFP format (12 vs 24 teams); the AR(1) trajectory with coefficient 0.7 and shock SD 4 points is an unfitted placeholder, so horizon probabilities are not credible beyond one or two seasons.
season_futures#tfut_horizon_model.what_would_resolve: Fit rating persistence and shock size on 2014-2025 team ratings, and carry format scenarios (12 and 24 teams) as explicit branches.

season_futures#title_only_series.description: Six series remain TITLE_ONLY (KXNCAAFBACC, BSEC, BB10, BB12, IVY, PAC10): for IVY whether a shared title pays and for PAC10 which entity is meant cannot be read; the four B-prefixed tickers are presumed duplicates of the current champion series but this is unverified.
season_futures#title_only_series.what_would_resolve: Fetch live or historical rules for the six TITLE_ONLY tickers and confirm whether the B-prefixed ones are retired duplicates.

team_total#run_defense_matchup_gap.description: cfb.run_defense is now attached to stage s2 and the opponent_matchup coverage, but its weight against overall def_ppa rushing and the need for a separate opponent rush-yards-allowed measure are untested; run-first offences were previously handled by overall def_ppa only.
team_total#run_defense_matchup_gap.what_would_resolve: Test whether run_defense adds explanatory power for run-first offences beyond def_ppa on historical team scoring, and whether rush yards allowed adds anything beyond rushing PPA allowed.

team_total#situational_effects_unmeasure.description: Rest, rivalry, lookahead and revenge effects on individual team scoring are not represented; large effects are plausible in particular games (rivalry week, trap games) but not established.
team_total#situational_effects_unmeasure.what_would_resolve: Test residual regressions of team points on rest and rivalry flags across seasons using non-market expectations.

team_total#team_total_ot_scope.description: The sampled KXNCAAFTEAMTOTAL rules do not state whether overtime points count; with overtime in a few percent of games and a lumpy score distribution, ignoring or including overtime changes rung probabilities near the median. Resolution selects the input set: overtime counted requires cfb.ot_model and the overtime archetype tie curve; regulation-only does not.
team_total#team_total_ot_scope.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules text of live team-total tickers and check the settlement of a past overtime game.

touchdown_scorer#kickoff_rule_regime.description: NCAA rule changes about kickoff returns and fair catches (recent seasons) affect special-teams touchdown exposure, but the exact effective seasons and their effect on return touchdowns are not verified here.
touchdown_scorer#kickoff_rule_regime.what_would_resolve: Read NCAA rule change summaries for 2022-2026 and compare return touchdown rates by regime.

touchdown_scorer#player_market_rules_unk.description: With no named-player touchdown series live, the settlement of a future player market (credit on fumble recoveries, overtime, a player who does not play: void versus No) cannot be read; the team-count series' texts in game_stat_props do not answer these player-level questions.
touchdown_scorer#player_market_rules_unk.what_would_resolve: If a named-player touchdown series is listed, read its rules_primary and rules_secondary and update this record.

touchdown_scorer#player_series_missing.description: The registered archetype is touchdown scorer markets (anytime and first player) but the ledger shows no live named-player touchdown series, only team and game counts; if player series are listed later the player-role inputs (td_rates, depth_chart, player_usage) become primary and are currently untestable.
touchdown_scorer#player_series_missing.what_would_resolve: Re-check the live Kalshi series list for named-player touchdown markets and re-key the archetype into player and team-count parts.

touchdown_scorer#weather_effect_on_td_sp.description: cfb.weather_pit is now attached (environment COVERED) but the size of wind and rain effects on the rushing/receiving touchdown split and on total TD count is not established.
touchdown_scorer#weather_effect_on_td_sp.what_would_resolve: Attach the weather vintage input and test the effect on TD type shares across several seasons.

unreg:awards_and_honors#award_stat_vinta.description: Voters see running statistics that are revised after games; the vintage of statistics available at each award's ballot date is not recorded, and the award bodies' ballot dates for 2026 are not confirmed.
unreg:awards_and_honors#award_stat_vinta.what_would_resolve: Record each award's 2026 ballot deadline and snapshot NCAA statistics at those dates.

unreg:awards_and_honors#electorate_unsou.description: The three-way electorate description (AP writers for conference awards, a foundation panel for Biletnikoff, a coaches/writers panel for coach awards) and a ballot collected at a fixed date before bowls are not stated in the sampled rules text; several AP award tickers are inactive, so ballot timing may differ.
unreg:awards_and_honors#electorate_unsou.what_would_resolve: Read each award body published voting procedure and ballot deadline, and check against the Kalshi rules text for each series.

unreg:awards_and_honors#finalist_procedu.description: The finalist contract resolves No if finalists are not announced before the winner, and the finalist count and announcement timing differ by award; the probability of a no-finalist procedure is not estimated and no per-award schedule is known.
unreg:awards_and_honors#finalist_procedu.what_would_resolve: Tabulate finalist announcement practice for each award since 2015 and read the full rules text for each finalist series.

unreg:awards_and_honors#heisman_not_live.description: The registered contract types name Heisman and Defensive Heisman but no live Heisman series was sampled; the voting mechanism for the Heisman (national electorate with regional bias) is therefore not verified against any live rules text.
unreg:awards_and_honors#heisman_not_live.what_would_resolve: Search for live Heisman series on Kalshi and sample their rules text before attributing Heisman mechanisms to this archetype.

unreg:awards_and_honors#script_effect_on.description: Game script (leading teams run, trailing teams pass) changes candidates' cumulative totals, but there is no input that models the script effect on a given player's usage; it may be material for receiver candidates whose team builds early leads.
unreg:awards_and_honors#script_effect_on.what_would_resolve: Estimate the elasticity of carries and targets to expected score margin from historical game logs.

unreg:awards_and_honors#voter_electorate.description: Vote totals are public for the Heisman but not for the AP conference awards or the Biletnikoff; the vote-share model for these awards must be built from winners and finalists only, making ranking beyond first place unobservable.
unreg:awards_and_honors#voter_electorate.what_would_resolve: Request ballot results from award bodies or assemble historical winners and finalists to estimate a rank-ordered model with censoring.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.description: The USA Today coach salary database covers public-school head coach contract summaries, not assistants or most private schools, and buyout step-downs (Jan 1 / Jun 30) computed 'from contract terms' require the contracts via slow, partial open-records requests; coverage of cfb.coach_buyout_exposure is therefore unknown rather than partial.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.what_would_resolve: Count head coaches in the sampled series with a retrievable contract and buyout schedule, and mark exposure missing where absent.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#dra.description: cfb.draft_declaration_propensity uses 'years since high school graduation >= 3' as the eligibility indicator without a cited source, and the share of declarations announced before versus after the bowl games is not measured, which sets the timing of the DRAFTDECLARE hazard.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#dra.what_would_resolve: Cite the NFL eligibility bylaw and tabulate 2015-2026 announcement dates against the early-entry deadline.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#pri.description: Buyouts and contract terms of private-school coaches (many in the sampled series) are not disclosed, so the buyout exposure input has missing values exactly for the cases where a market exists; imputation error is unknown.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#pri.what_would_resolve: Search for credible reporting of contract terms for private schools and validate imputation against known disclosures.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#sma.description: Only about 15 to 25 FBS head coaches change jobs a year and CFP expansion decisions or conference leaves are rare, so any hazard fitted to the history has wide error and structural breaks (revenue sharing, portal, realignment); the weight of base rate versus news is not estimable well.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#sma.what_would_resolve: Pool 20 years of coach exits, test structural breaks since 2021, and use a Bayesian hierarchical prior with explicit uncertainty.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#sou.description: The sampled rules refer to Source Agencies for confirmation but the list of agencies is not in the sample; what counts as credible confirmation (for example a single reporter, an official school statement) affects resolution timing and the reliability weights used for reports.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#sou.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules and definitions (Source Agencies list) of live series and tabulate cases where timing differed from the actual event.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#tra.description: Revenue-sharing and NIL offers, probably the main driver of a named player's destination, are not observed in any public dataset; the available trackers report commits only after they occur. Without it cfb.transfer_destination_candidate_model has no primary feature and is secondary at best; the series should be re-keyed to a player-career-decision archetype.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#tra.what_would_resolve: Evaluate whether credible reporting of NIL interest has predictive value before commits using a past season of trackers.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#tru.description: The sampled secondary rules for KXNCAAFCFPEXPAND, KXNCAAFTRANSFER, KXNCAAFCONFLEAVE and KXNCAAFDRAFTDECLARE stop at 600 characters; for CFPEXPAND the cut falls inside the definition of how participating teams are counted (opening or play-in round), which decides whether a proposed format is 'exactly 24'.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#tru.what_would_resolve: Fetch the full rules text of these four series from Kalshi and re-read the team-count, destination and trigger clauses.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U1.description: The sampled rules_secondary is truncated after 'the market will resolve to a fai', so what happens if the game is not started within 48 hours (fair-price, void, or another fallback) and which agency's score is the source of truth cannot be read.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U1.what_would_resolve: Capture the full rules_secondary text of several KXNCAAF1HFT markets from the Kalshi API or rules page.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U2.description: Only one market of the series was sampled; it is unknown whether every game lists all six half/full cells or only a few, which decides whether partition coherence can be enforced across markets.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U2.what_would_resolve: List all markets of several KXNCAAF1HFT events and count cells per event.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U3.description: Rule changes (2021 OT two-point shootouts, 2023 running clock after first downs except last two minutes of a half) change drives per half and OT outcomes, so pooled 2014+ transition matrices may be biased for current seasons.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U3.what_would_resolve: Re-fit the transition matrix and half-tie mass on 2023+ only and test for structural change against earlier seasons.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U4.description: The halftime adjustment differential may be pure noise after garbage-time filtering and shrinkage; its sign stability across seasons for a given staff is untested.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U4.what_would_resolve: Split-half reliability of the staff differential across seasons; drop if correlation is near zero.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U5.description: Conference availability reports are claimed to exist for Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 conference games, but their start seasons, publication deadlines, status granularity and archive access were not verified by the resolver and non-conference games are uncovered.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U5.what_would_resolve: Read each conference 2026 availability-report policy, archive several weeks with capture timestamps and measure timeliness versus kickoff and QB-change coverage.

unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U6.description: The size of tie-at-half mass in close games (order of ten percent) and how the second-half receiver shifts the tie-cell winner split are hypotheses, not measured values, under the 2023+ clock rules.
unreg:half_full_double_result#A-U6.what_would_resolve: Measure half-tie frequency by expected-margin and total bin and the tied-half winner split by second-half receiver on CFBD line scores for 2023 onward.

unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U1.description: All four sampled pre-pack markets have empty rules_secondary, so overtime inclusion for the spread and total legs, the handling of a postponed or cancelled leg game, and the settlement source are not stated anywhere in the sample.
unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U1.what_would_resolve: Capture the full rules and the Kalshi MVE product terms for these series and check how any finalized pack with a moved game settled.

unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U2.description: The size of cross-game dependence from shared conference-offset error, and its sign per pair, is unknown; it may be negligible relative to game noise or material for 3-4 leg packs that mix conferences in the CFP.
unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U2.what_would_resolve: Back-test product-of-marginals versus correlated-draw forecasts on 2014+ bowl slates for combinations of 3-4 legs.

unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U3.description: Pack composition is chosen by Kalshi (which legs are bundled), and selection may favour popular favourites; the bundle selection is not a model input but could bias any calibration study based on listed packs only.
unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U3.what_would_resolve: Collect all listed packs per slate and compare their leg mix to the full set of available games.

unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U4.description: Conference availability reports may cover regular-season conference legs of pre-packs, but coverage of postseason CFP and bowl games by any official report is unverified, as are publication deadlines.
unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs#B-U4.what_would_resolve: Check whether conference or CFP availability reports were published for the 2025-26 postseason games and archive timestamps versus kickoff.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#ap_points_s.description: AP poll points and first-place votes (needed for ballot_points_gap and bubble_proximity_state) are assumed exposed by the CFBD rankings endpoint and AP 'others receiving votes' lists; the AP Top 25 archive since 1990 and the claim that individual ballots are published but not collected in a free structured database were not checked.
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#ap_points_s.what_would_resolve: Query the CFBD rankings endpoint and the AP website archive for several seasons, record which fields (points, first-place votes, others receiving votes) exist, and search for a ballot database.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#committee_p.description: The committee's protocol (how it weighs conference champions, how injuries are treated, whether rankings are built afresh) changes occasionally and the 2026 protocol is not verified here; the model weights derived from 2014-2025 may not hold.
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#committee_p.what_would_resolve: Read the CFP protocol document for the 2026 season and compare to previous seasons' protocols.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#rank_exactn.description: Exact-rank markets (rank 25 on Nov 24) are sensitive to small differences in ordering among many similar teams; the amount of randomness in committee ordering near the cut line is not known and cannot be separated from resume differences with the available sample.
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#rank_exactn.what_would_resolve: Evaluate predicted versus realised exact ranks near rank 25 across committee releases from 2014 to determine residual noise.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#template_de.description: The KXNCAAFCFPPOLL sampled rules text includes an unfilled template token (|| Time Period ||) instead of the season; the contract's intended ranking date and fallback rule therefore cannot be confirmed from the sampled text alone. Only one ticker per series was sampled: KXNCAAFTOPCFPPOLL has the season filled in, but other KXNCAAFCFPPOLL tickers may carry the same unfilled token and should all be checked as a settlement risk.
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#template_de.what_would_resolve: Read the rules text of every live KXNCAAFCFPPOLL and KXNCAAFTOPCFPPOLL ticker and flag any unfilled template tokens.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#voter_level.description: Individual AP ballots are public (published by AP) but not collected in any free structured database, and the CFP committee does not publish ballots; voter-level heterogeneity, which drives the churn of the number-one slot, cannot be modelled without scraping ballots.
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings#voter_level.what_would_resolve: Scrape AP ballot pages for recent seasons and test whether voter-level features improve the successor-given-loss prediction.

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U1.description: The rules are truncated before the source-of-truth clause, so it is unknown whether NCAA official statistics, conference statistics or a provider such as ESPN settles the leader, which matters for half sacks and stat corrections.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U1.what_would_resolve: Capture the full rules_secondary text and check a settled prior-season leader market against NCAA and ESPN totals.

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U2.description: KXNCAAFLEADER says 'Division I college football'; it is unclear whether FCS players are eligible, and FCS rushing leaders can rival FBS totals, which changes the field.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U2.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules or ask Kalshi whether 'Division I' means FBS only; check prior settlement against FBS and FCS leaders.

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U3.description: 'Does not play in the ACC' is undefined for a player who transfers mid-year or appears only on special teams; whether any snap counts as playing is not stated.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U3.what_would_resolve: Full rules text or Kalshi clarification of 'play' (any snap versus recorded statistic).

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U4.description: Pass-rush snap counts needed for the sacks race are not in free sources (CFBD has no snap counts); PFF has them behind a paywall, so the free version must proxy by team defensive snaps and depth position.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U4.what_would_resolve: License PFF College or validate a free proxy (defensive snaps x depth role) against PFF pass-rush snaps for a sample.

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U5.description: The reviewer reports mandatory conference availability reports for Big Ten (2023), SEC (2024), ACC and Big 12 (2025) conference games; start dates, deadlines, timestamps and archive access were not verified here and non-conference weeks have no report.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U5.what_would_resolve: Read each conference 2026 availability-report policy, archive several weeks of reports with capture timestamps and measure coverage of non-conference weeks.

unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U6.description: It is unverified whether CFBD or NCAA free data expose half-sack credit and timestamped post-game stat revisions; the 0.5-lattice tie-mass calibration and stat-correction handling depend on it.
unreg:season_stat_leader#C-U6.what_would_resolve: Pull a settled season from CFBD and stats.ncaa.org, compare sack totals and half credits per player, and check whether revision history or timestamps exist.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#avail.description: Late availability of a quarterback, pass rusher or kicker changes the relevant rate, but no input is attached for it and the size of the shift relative to noise (small counts) is unknown.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#avail.what_would_resolve: Test the effect of known quarterback and kicker changes on sack, interception and field-goal counts in a historical sample.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#delay.description: cfb.weather_delay_hazard assumes CFBD or another source documents weather delays back to 2010 (otherwise reconstructed from game notes), that NCAA and conference lightning protocol (suspend at a nearby strike, 30-minute reset) maps onto the contract wording 'officially delayed', and that NWS thunderstorm probability and GLM lightning archives are usable at game-window granularity; none was checked, so the input stays secondary.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#delay.what_would_resolve: Build a sample of delayed games from play-by-play and news for several seasons, check source coverage, and test whether forecast thunderstorm probability predicts them.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#delay.description: KXNCAAFDELAY resolves on an official weather delay with no minimum duration, but the sample does not say who declares a delay or which source documents it (game broadcast, stadium announcement, box score note); very short holds could go unrecorded.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#delay.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules and settlement notes for past delay tickets and identify the documenting source.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#half_.description: The sampled secondary texts for TEAMSACK and TEAMTO are truncated: whether shared (half) sacks count as a whole team sack, and whether fumbles lost on punts and kickoffs count as turnovers gained, are not visible, and each choice changes the mean count by a few tenths.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#half_.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules text of live TEAMSACK and TEAMTO tickers, and check settlement of past games with shared sacks and special-teams fumbles.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#light.description: Historical lightning data suitable for delay calibration (strike-level archive) is paid (Vaisala) or in satellite products whose usability is unverified here; a delay record set for 2010-2025 would need manual construction from game notes.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#light.what_would_resolve: Check GOES-R GLM archive accessibility and assemble delay records from a sample of 200 games to test calibration.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#stat_.description: After the reconciliation team stat counts are split between game_stat_props (yards, touchdowns, rushing attempts) and this archetype (sacks, interceptions, turnovers, field goals, two-point conversions, delays), and cfb.opp_dropback_volume overlaps cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts and cfb.state_dependent_pace used there.
unreg:team_event_counting_specials#stat_.what_would_resolve: Alias cfb.opp_dropback_volume to the game_stat_props dropback input in the catalog, or document why the defensive view needs a separate definition.
